crossRefs.note: Jacob heard Laban’s sons’ words, saying, “Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s. He has obtained all this…
For all the riches which God has taken away from our father are ours and our children’s. Now then, whatever God has…
On that day, King Ahasuerus gave the house of Haman, the Jews’ enemy, to Esther the queen. Mordecai came before the…
The king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it to Mordecai. Esther set Mordecai over the house…
For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.
A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’
